fields.name: num
fields.coerce: none: used as an array key, so `"2"` also works. Any other value reads an empty slot
fields.description: The slot of the stack of tokens (an item of type `token`: `funtoken`, `monstertoken`, `pvptoken` or `friendtoken`).

fields.name: name
fields.description: What to buy: a key of `G.tokens[token]`. The key is an `ItemName`, or `<item>-<data>`: then the new item is `<item>` with `data: "<data>"` (for example `"cxjar-xgravestone2"`).

fields.name: q
fields.coerce: compared with `!=` to the quantity of the stack, so `"140"` also matches 140
fields.description: A safety check: the quantity of the token stack now. If it does not match, the server refuses. This stops a second buy on a stack that changed.

responses.name: Success
responses.when: All checks pass. The server removes the price in tokens and adds the item. A price below 1 means that 1 token buys `parseInt(1 / price)` units.

fields.name: num
fields.description: The slot that got the item.

fields.name: cevent
fields.description: Tells the official client to fire its `exchange_buy` code event.

rows.when: No character. The handler reads `player.items` before it checks `player`, and throws.

confirm.note: `player.items` on `undefined` throws; the wrapper adds 16 to the call cost and sends `game_error` `"ERROR!"` (or `limitdcreport` and a disconnect over the limit)

rows.when: The character is in the bank.
The slot is empty, or the item is not of type `token`.
The token stack has the lock `l`.
`q` is not the quantity of the stack.

You are more than `B.sell_dist` (400 px) from the NPC of the token on `main`: `G.items[token].npc` (`monsterhunter` for `monstertoken`), else `<token>s`. A character with a `computer` passes this check.
The stack has fewer tokens than the price.
The item does not fit in the inventory, and the token stack does not become empty.

also.when: Success. Every client whose view holds the token NPC.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The token name plus `s`, for example `"funtokens"` or `"monstertokens"`.

also.summary: Your state with `reopen: true`. `items` and `esize` show the purchase.
